# Reference: layouts and components

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-manifest.mjs from layouts.json; do not edit -->

Layouts go in a slide's frontmatter (`layout: two-cols`), their props as frontmatter keys. Components go in the Markdown (`<Chart :data="[1, 2]" />`): `:prop` for values that aren't strings, kebab-case or camelCase both work.

## Layouts

### `center`

Centered content

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `contentMaxWidth` | String | `"64rem"` |  |
| `padding` | String | `"4rem"` |  |

### `cover`

Title slides

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `contentMaxWidth` | String | `"48rem"` |  |
| `padding` | String | `"4rem 6rem"` |  |

### `default`

Content slide (title pinned at the top)

No props (its content is the slot).

### `document`

A long document on one slide (a spec, an ADR, a README): its own `##` headings become an index rail, and each click scrolls the text to the next section (a click on the rail jumps there). The steps count in the slide's clicks; an export shows the last section (or every one with --with-clicks).

No props (its content is the slot).

### `end`

Title slides

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `contentMaxWidth` | String | `"48rem"` |  |
| `padding` | String | `"4rem 6rem"` |  |

### `exercise`

An exercise or lab: its number and time on top, the task (the slide's content) on the left, and on the right how to work and what to expect, with a countdown for the time (its start button: it waits for you). Frontmatter: exercise (the number or a label), time ("15min", 15), method, expected, countdown: false.

No props (its content is the slot).

### `fact`

Emphasis slides

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `contentMaxWidth` | String | `"48rem"` |  |
| `padding` | String | `"4rem 6rem"` |  |

### `speaker`

About the speaker: the person on the left, the slide's text (a short bio, topics) on the right. From the slide's `speaker:` (name, role, affiliation, avatar, links), else the headmatter's, else its author and affiliation. (Not a top-level `name:`: Slidev takes that as the slide's title.)

No props (its content is the slot).

## Components

### `<Badge>`

variant: default blue green red yellow cyan gray |

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | String | `"default"` |  |

### `<BeforeAfter>`

Before and after, side by side with an arrow between (slots before / after: code blocks, images, text); `delta` sums up the change

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `afterLabel` | String | `"After"` |  |
| `beforeLabel` | String | `"Before"` |  |
| `delta` | String | `""` | Shown under the arrow, e.g. "4× faster" |

### `<Benchmark>`

Benchmark bars: one per result, the winner lit, each with its value and how it compares to the baseline (the first)

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lowerIsBetter` | Boolean | `true` | true: smaller wins (time, latency); false: bigger wins (throughput) |
| `results` (required) | Array |  | [{ label, value }]: the first is the baseline |
| `title` | String | `""` |  |
| `unit` | String | `""` |  |

### `<BlockDiagram>`

Named blocks on a stage, and a focus frame that moves from block to block on each click, with a caption per step. The steps count in the slide's clicks (as <v-clicks>); an export shows the last one.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `blocks` (required) | Array |  | [{ id, label, sub, x, y, w, h, color }]: position and size in % of the stage |
| `height` | String | `"16rem"` | The stage's height (16rem) |
| `steps` | Array | `[]` | The focus, one click each: block ids, or { block, caption } |

### `<Browser>`

A browser window: macOS dots, a tab with the title, an address bar, and the page: an image (`src`), a live page (`iframe`) or the slot

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alt` | String | `""` |  |
| `height` | String | `""` | The page's height (the window's minus its bar); auto by default |
| `iframe` | Boolean | `false` | Load `url` live in the window |
| `src` | String | `""` | A screenshot to show as the page |
| `title` | String | `""` |  |
| `url` | String | `""` | The address shown (and loaded, with `iframe`) |
| `width` | String | `""` |  |

### `<Chart>`

A bar or line chart, drawn in SVG (no chart library): one or several series over `labels`, in the theme's colors; it grows in once the slide has arrived (exports show it drawn)

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` (required) | Array |  | Numbers (one series), or [{ name, values, color }] |
| `labels` | Array | `[]` |  |
| `max` | Number |  | The top of the axis; by default a round number above the largest value |
| `title` | String | `""` |  |
| `type` | String | `"bar"` | bar (default) \| line |
| `unit` | String | `""` |  |

### `<ChevronFlow>`

A process as arrow-shaped steps, left to right; `active` lights one

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | Number \| String | `0` | The step to light (1-based); the ones before it read as done |
| `steps` (required) | Array |  | Titles, or { title, desc, color } |

### `<ClickTabs>`

Tabs whose pane changes on each click: one window, several versions (kernel v1 / v2 / v3, C++ / Python). It looks like a code group (styles/code-theme.css) and claims its clicks from the slide, so the slide's click count includes them, as with <v-clicks>.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | Number \| String | `1` | The tab shown first (1-based), without steps |
| `steps` | Boolean | `true` | false: no clicks, the tabs switch on a click of their own |
| `tabs` (required) | Array |  | The tab labels; the panes are the slots tab1, tab2, … in this order |

### `<ComplexityTable>`

title, rows ([{ n, target, algo, complexity, highlight }]), showComplexity |

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rows` | Array | `[{"n":"$N \\le 10$","target":"$O(N!)$","algo":"Brute Force / Permutation","complexity":"$O(N!)$"},{"n":"$N \\le 20$","target":"$O(2^N)$","algo":"Bitmask DP / Backtracking","complexity":"$O(2^N \\cdot N)$"},{"n":"$N \\le 500$","target":"$O(N^3)$","algo":"Floyd-Warshall / DP","complexity":"$O(N^3)$"},{"n":"$N \\le 5{,}000$","target":"$O(N^2)$","algo":"DP / Brute Force","complexity":"$O(N^2)$"},{"n":"$N \\le 10^5$","target":"$O(N \\log N)$","algo":"Sort / Segment Tree","complexity":"$O(N \\log N)$"},{"n":"$N \\le 10^6$","target":"$O(N)$","algo":"Greedy / Linear Scan","complexity":"$O(N)$"},{"n":"$N \\le 10^{18}$","target":"$O(\\log N)$","algo":"Binary Search / Math","complexity":"$O(\\log N)$"}]` |  |
| `showComplexity` | Boolean | `true` |  |
| `title` | String | `""` |  |

### `<Countdown>`

minutes, size (preset sm default lg xl, or any CSS length, as <QRCode>), label, autoStart (false: a ▶ start button), showZero. Click the timer to pause / resume, double-click to reset |

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `autoStart` | Boolean | `true` | false: a start button; the timer starts on click |
| `label` | String | `""` |  |
| `minutes` | Number | `5` |  |
| `showZero` | Boolean | `true` |  |
| `size` | String | `"default"` | sm \| default \| lg \| xl, or any CSS length (e.g. "2.5rem"), as QRCode |

### `<Cycle>`

A cycle: items around a ring with arrows between them, and an optional word in the middle (a loop, an orbit)

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `center` | String | `""` |  |
| `items` (required) | Array |  | Titles, or { title, color }, clockwise from the top |
| `size` | String | `"20rem"` | The diagram's width and height (20rem) |

### `<DrawOn>`

Draws the lines of the SVG inside it, as if by hand, once the slide has arrived (again on each visit); exports and reduced motion show them drawn

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `duration` | String | `"1.5s"` | How long the drawing takes ("1.5s", "800ms") |

### `<EChart>`

An Apache ECharts chart in the theme's colors (series palette, text, grid lines), for what the SVG <Chart> doesn't draw. ECharts is an optional peer dependency: `npm i -D echarts` in a deck that uses this (Slidev only loads the components a deck uses, so others don't need it). Drawn as SVG (sharp in exports, no animation there); it plays again each time the slide is shown.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `height` | String | `"18rem"` |  |
| `option` (required) | Object |  | An ECharts option object |

### `<ErrorSpotlight>`

A bug story in three panels: the error, its root cause, the fix (slots error / cause / fix, Markdown and code welcome)

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `causeTitle` | String | `"Root cause"` |  |
| `errorTitle` | String | `"Error"` |  |
| `fixTitle` | String | `"Fix"` |  |

### `<FloatImage>`

src, alt, caption, position (left/right), width, rounded |

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alt` | String | `""` |  |
| `caption` | String | `""` |  |
| `position` | String | `"right"` |  |
| `rounded` | Boolean | `true` |  |
| `src` (required) | String |  |  |
| `width` | String | `"40%"` |  |

### `<Footnote>`

(slot; pinned at the bottom of the slide; a column layout's bottom slot stays above it) |

No props (its content is the slot).

### `<Ghost>`

A giant faint glyph behind the slide's content: a number, a word, an emoji. Placed in a corner (or the middle), it doesn't take room.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | String | `"primary"` |  |
| `opacity` | Number \| String |  | 0–1 (0.07 by default) |
| `position` | String | `"bottom-right"` | bottom-right (default) \| top-right \| bottom-left \| top-left \| center |
| `size` | String | `""` | CSS font size (18rem by default) |
| `text` (required) | String \| Number |  |  |

### `<GithubCard>`

A GitHub issue or pull request as a card (what you give it; nothing is fetched, so it works offline and in exports)

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `author` | String | `""` |  |
| `labels` | Array | `[]` |  |
| `number` | Number \| String | `""` |  |
| `repo` (required) | String |  | owner/name |
| `state` | String | `"open"` | open \| closed \| merged \| draft |
| `title` (required) | String |  |  |
| `type` | String | `"issue"` | issue \| pr |

### `<GoogleForm>`

A quiz or poll on Google Forms: a QR code and a short link so the room opens it on their phones, the form itself beside it (`embed`), and the results from a published Google Sheet chart (`results`). Exports show the QR code and the link instead of the live frames.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `embed` | Boolean | `false` | Show the form beside the code |
| `link` | String | `""` | The link under the code, if not the form's own |
| `prompt` | String | `""` |  |
| `qrSize` | String | `"lg"` |  |
| `results` | String | `""` | A published Sheet chart's address (File → Share → Publish to web → the chart, embed): shown instead of the form |
| `title` | String | `""` |  |
| `url` (required) | String |  | The form's address (its "Send" link: docs.google.com/forms/d/e/…/viewform, or forms.gle/…) |

### `<HexGrid>`

Hexagons in a honeycomb (a triad of three, or more): one idea each

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | Number \| String |  | Hexagons in a row (3 items: a triad, 2 over 1) |
| `items` (required) | Array |  | Titles, or { title, icon, color } |
| `size` | String | `"9rem"` | A hexagon's width (9rem) |

### `<ImageCompare>`

Two images of the same size, one over the other, with a handle to drag (or a range to set) that reveals the `after` one; exports show the split at `position`

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `after` (required) | String |  |  |
| `afterLabel` | String | `"After"` |  |
| `before` (required) | String |  |  |
| `beforeLabel` | String | `"Before"` |  |
| `position` | Number | `50` | Where the split starts, in % from the left |
| `width` | String | `"100%"` |  |

### `<ImageTour>`

A walk through a screenshot (an Nsight timeline, a dashboard): one spot per click. `mode`: callout (a numbered pin and its note), mask (the rest dims) or zoom (the image zooms onto the spot). Spots are in fractions of the image (0–1), so they stay put at any size. Steps count in the slide's clicks; an export shows the last one (callouts: all pins).

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alt` | String | `""` |  |
| `mode` | String | `"callout"` | callout (default) \| mask \| zoom |
| `spots` (required) | Array |  | [{ x, y, w, h, label }]: the spot's center (x, y) and size (w, h), in fractions of the image |
| `src` (required) | String |  |  |
| `width` | String | `"100%"` |  |

### `<Interactive>`

Something live (its slot: an explorer, a diagram editor, a widget) that has a still for exports. In the room it shows the slot, or with `dialog`, the still, and a click opens the slot in a dialog over the slide (Esc or a click outside closes it). Exports show the still.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alt` | String | `""` |  |
| `dialog` | Boolean | `false` | Show the still and open the slot in a dialog on click |
| `image` (required) | String |  | The still, for exports (and the dialog's preview) |
| `width` | String | `"100%"` |  |

|

| Prop | Type | Default | |

href, title, description, icon, compact |

### `<LiveDemo>`

A live site in a browser bar, with a way out when the network fails: a status dot (connecting / live / offline), a "video" toggle to a recording, and in exports the `poster` image. If the page hasn't loaded within `timeout` ms (or the room is offline) it switches to the video by itself. `scale` shrinks a desktop page to fit; `crop` hides that many pixels at its top (a site's own header).

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crop` | Number | `0` | Pixels hidden at the page's top |
| `height` | String | `"20rem"` |  |
| `label` | String | `""` |  |
| `poster` | String | `""` | The still for exports (and the video's first frame) |
| `scale` | Number | `1` | The page's zoom: 0.5 shows a 2× wider page |
| `src` (required) | String |  |  |
| `timeout` | Number | `8000` | ms to wait for the page before switching to the video |
| `video` | String | `""` | A recording to fall back on |
| `width` | String | `"100%"` |  |

### `<LogoWall>`

Logos (sponsors, users, tools) in even rows, quiet (grey) until hovered

### `<Meter>`

A meter: a labelled bar filled to value / max. With `animate` it fills once the slide has arrived (exports show it full). Thresholds can recolor it: `warn` / `danger` (as values) turn it yellow / red.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `animate` | Boolean | `false` |  |
| `color` | String | `"primary"` |  |
| `danger` | Number \| String |  |  |
| `label` | String | `""` |  |
| `max` | Number \| String | `100` |  |
| `showValue` | Boolean \| String | `true` | The number at the right: true shows "value / max" as a percent; a string is shown as is |
| `size` | String | `"md"` | sm \| md (default) \| lg |
| `unit` | String | `""` | A unit after the percent-less value, e.g. "GB/s" (then value / max is shown) |
| `value` (required) | Number \| String |  |  |
| `warn` | Number \| String |  | Values from which the bar turns yellow / red (higher is worse) |

A big picture or diagram (its slot) that pans and zooms in place: the wheel or +/− zooms around the pointer, dragging pans, double-click or 0 resets. The slide's keys still work; exports show the start view.

| `initial` | Number | `1` | The zoom to start at |
| `max` | Number | `6` |  |

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api` | String | `""` | Use a QR image service instead ({data}: the encoded url, {size}: pixels) |
| `caption` | String | `""` |  |
| `ecc` | String | `"M"` | Error correction L \| M \| Q \| H; raised for free when the symbol has room |
| `size` | String | `"default"` | sm \| default \| lg \| xl, or any CSS length (e.g. "150px") |
| `slide` | Boolean \| Number | `false` | Without `url`: true links to the slide it's on, a number to that slide |
| `src` | String | `""` | Use your own image instead |
| `url` | String | `""` | What the code holds; empty: this deck's address (see `slide`) |

### `<Radar>`

A radar (spider) chart in SVG: one polygon per series over the axes

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `axes` (required) | Array |  |  |
| `data` (required) | Array |  | Numbers (one series), or [{ name, values, color }] |
| `max` | Number |  | The outer ring's value (the largest value by default) |
| `title` | String | `""` |  |

### `<SpeechBubble>`

A speech bubble: a glass bubble with a tail toward the speaker, and an optional name (and avatar) beside it.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `avatar` | String | `""` | An image path (public/ or a URL) |
| `color` | String | `"primary"` | The bubble's tint: a theme color name or any CSS color |
| `name` | String | `""` |  |
| `side` | String | `"left"` | Where the speaker is: left (default) or right; the tail points there |

### `<StackDiagram>`

A software stack, top layer first (App → cuBLAS → Runtime → Driver → GPU); `active` lights one layer, and a layer can note what it adds

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | String \| Number | `""` | A layer to light: its title or its place (1-based) |
| `layers` (required) | Array |  | Top first: titles, or { title, note, color } |

### `<StageProgress>`

No props (its content is the slot).

### `<Stat>`

value (as written: "$4.2M", "98.5%", "1,024"), label, delta ("+12%"; its sign picks ▲ / ▼), good (up or down: which way is green), count (counts up from 0 when the slide arrives; exports show the figure), color, size (sm / default / lg), plain (no card) |

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | String | `"primary"` | primary (default), blue, cyan, green, yellow, red, gray, or a CSS color |
| `count` | Boolean | `false` | Count up from 0 when the slide arrives (exports show the figure) |
| `delta` | String | `""` | The change, as written: "+12%", "-3.1 pts"; its sign picks the arrow |
| `good` | String | `"up"` | Which way is good for the delta: up (default) or down (latency, cost) |
| `label` | String | `""` |  |
| `plain` | Boolean | `false` | No card around it |
| `size` | String | `"default"` | sm \| default \| lg |
| `value` (required) | String \| Number |  | The figure as written: "$4.2M", "98.5%", "1,024", 42 |

### `<StickyNote>`

A sticky note: a small, slightly turned glass card in a color, for an aside pinned onto a slide. Place it with classes (absolute right-8 top-20) or inline.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | String | `"yellow"` | A theme color name (yellow by default) or any CSS color |
| `rotate` | Number \| String | `-1.5` | Degrees it is turned (−1.5 by default; 0 for straight) |
| `title` | String | `""` |  |
| `width` | String | `""` | CSS width (14rem by default) |

### `<StoryBox>`

title, variant (history insight warning tip person), year, source, color, icon |

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | String | `""` | Custom accent color / icon; override the variant's |
| `icon` | String | `""` |  |
| `source` | String | `""` |  |
| `title` | String | `"History"` |  |
| `variant` | String | `"history"` |  |
| `year` | String | `""` |  |

### `<TeamGrid>`

People in even rows: avatar (or initials), name, role

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | Number \| String |  |  |
| `people` (required) | Array |  | [{ name, role, avatar }] |

### `<Timeline>`

items ([{ title, year, desc, color }]), active (a static highlight), steps (each click reveals the next item and moves the highlight; counts in the slide's clicks), animate (items fade in top to bottom when the slide arrives) |

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | Number \| String | `-1` | A static highlight (index); with `steps` the newest item is highlighted |
| `animate` | Boolean | `false` | Items fade in top to bottom once the slide has arrived (anim-fade-up) |
| `items` (required) | Array |  |  |
| `steps` | Boolean | `false` | Each click on the slide reveals the next item (counts in the slide's clicks, like <v-clicks>) |

### `<Transcript>`

A chat or agent session, one turn per click (user, agent, tool), in a window of fixed height that scrolls to the newest turn; a badge counts the turns gone out of view above. Exports show the last turns.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `height` | String | `"20rem"` |  |
| `start` | Number | `1` | Turns shown before the first click (1) |
| `turns` (required) | Array |  | [{ role: user \| agent \| tool \| system, text, name }] |
